paper.title: Helix: Serving Large Language Models over Heterogeneous GPUs and Network via Max-Flow

reading.scope: Physical pages 1–15: complete body and artifact appendix within this copy; pages 16–17 bibliography inspected as locators only. No artifact execution or cited-paper reading inferred.

findings.finding: Per-node profiled service rates, model-layer placement, node NIC limits and link bandwidth are converted into capacities. The max-flow bound assumes this fixed abstraction; the joint MILP does not prove optimal real deployment under every workload or solve-time budget.

Partial inference permits intersecting pipelines with overlapping layer placement. A request receives one path, retained for its autoregressive tokens; token-level work does not imply free rerouting at each decode step.
Admission uses expected output length and a KV high-water mark. This is a statistical estimate; long-tail reasoning requests require revisiting capacity and admission.

vLLM 0.4.0.post1 prototype uses 24 single-GPU nodes (4 A100 40GB, 8 L4, 12 T4) and 10Gb/s. Geographic and 42-node heterogeneous experiments are simulated. Requests above 2048 input or 1024 output tokens were removed; decode throughput and all-token flow use different denominators.

Higher aggregate throughput can accompany higher individual latency. Ablations fix other components; future integration suggestions for PD, chunking or speculation are not implemented support evidence.
Artifact uses dummy model weights. Performance experiments do not establish output correctness or production readiness; archived later master is versioned separately.

paper_to_framework_gap: Paper baseline vLLM 0.4.0.post1; separately inspect fixed 2025-10-15 Helix master, vLLM v0.10.1 guide and fixed 2026-09-07 vLLM source.

Layer partition configuration is not per-request network-aware path assignment. The inspected Qwen3 implementation inherits a hidden_states plus residual PP interface; model-level arrow bytes need implementation-specific correction.
Profile per phase, batch and context; retain path-associated KV, tail behavior and latency constraints. No framework-wide absence claim from the selected files.

editorial_decision.placement: Existing 6.2.3, experiment 6-2 and figure 6-2 variant; case links to chapters 7 and 9. No new section or core experiment.
